title: Task Priority System
introduction: Add priority levels to tasks so users can focus on what matters most.
goals: Allow assigning priority to any task

user_stories.title: Add priority field to the tasks table
user_stories.description: As a developer, I want to store task priority so that it persists across sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Add priority column to tasks table with values high, medium, low

user_stories.title: Display priority indicator on task cards
user_stories.description: As a user, I want to see task priority at a glance so that I can focus on the most important tasks first.
acceptance_criteria: Each task card shows a visible priority badge
Badge colors distinguish high, medium, and low priority
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

functional_requirements: FR-1: The system must persist task priority in storage.
FR-2: The system must render priority on each task card.
non_goals: No priority-based notifications in phase one
design_considerations: Reuse the existing badge component if possible
technical_considerations: Priority state should be exposed through existing task query APIs
success_metrics: Users can identify high-priority tasks without opening task details
open_questions: Should priority also affect default task sorting?
